title: Beyond Adult and COMPAS: Fairness in Multi-Class Prediction
reasoning: The paper focuses on algorithmic fairness by introducing a new method (FairProjection) and benchmarking it against existing methods using specific fairness metrics (statistical parity, equalized odds). While 'fairness' is an ethical concept, the paper's scope is technical implementation and comparison of methods to achieve these metrics, rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, morals, or religious/faith systems themselves.
